subject: I just want to have simple black grid lines

messages.author: f5bec70b36df06aa
messages.subject: I just want to have simple black grid lines
parts:
Hi @all

Sometimes it is really frustrating to work with R as a novice
especially when one wants to change simple things and even after a
couple of hours of google research no solution has been found.

I have the following simple dotplot graph:

read.csv("http://dl.dropbox.com/u/4236038/dotplot_sw.csv") ->
nutrients
p <- ggplot(nutrients, aes(x=diss_N, y=d15N))
none <- theme_blank()
p+geom_point(aes(shape=factor(Catchment)), size=3) + theme_bw() +
opts(legend.key=theme_rect(fill=NULL,colour="white")) +
opts(legend.position = "bottom") + xlab(expression(paste('DIN (mg',~
L^{-1},')'))) + ylab(expression(paste(delta^{15},'N (DIN)'~'(\u2030
AIR)'))) + opts(axis.text.x = theme_text(size=13), axis.text.y =
theme_text(size=13, hjust = 0.8), legend.title = theme_text(size=15),
legend.text = theme_text(size=15), axis.title.x = theme_text(size=15),
axis.title.y = theme_text(size=15, angle = 90)) + opts(legend.position
= c(0.9, 0.9))+ opts(legend.background=theme_rect(col = "black")) +
scale_shape("Catchments")

I think most of the journals don't like the grey grid lines so I just
want to have them in black. However, none of the following additions
did it:

+ opts(panel.background = theme_rect(colour = black))
+ opts(axis.line = theme_segment(colour = "black")) this only changed
the x and y axis lines to black but the default grey was on top of the
black as well.

The legend has a nice and beautiful simple black frame. That is what I
would like to have for the entire grid except the grid lines within
the graph.

Any help would be greatly appreciated.

Cheers,
Martin

messages.author: 27405c4b711a1080
messages.subject: Re: I just want to have simple black grid lines
parts:
You're not using the right calls to adjust the color of the grid lines. From the wiki... https://github.com/hadley/ggplot2/wiki/%2Bopts%28%29-List

panel.grid.minor (line)


plot + opts(panel.grid.minor = theme_line(colour = 'red', size = 3, linetype = 'dashed'))

panel.grid.major (line)


plot + opts(panel.grid.major = theme_line(colour = 'red', size = 3, linetype = 'dashed'))

B

messages.subject: Re: I just want to have simple black grid lines
parts:
Thanks B

That was of great help. I actually meant the "plot + opts(panel.border
= theme_rect(colour = 'black'))" call. That did the job and changed
the colour of the plot grid lines (I meant the outer lines) to black.

Cheers,
Martin
